title: Home explanation
description: Short in-app guidance for the selected screen.

sections.title: Affinity slider
sections.blurb: Pick how much affinity you feel for the card.
sections.contentHtml: Tap or drag the Affinity slider from 1 to 10. The Go button appears only after you pick a value.

sections.title: Affinity and group chats
sections.blurb: Your answer helps find a small group where conversation is easier to start.
sections.contentHtml:
When you choose 1-10, you are saying how much you would like to talk with this person. That number is not used alone: it matters more when interest is mutual, recent, and stronger than the usual background noise.

If several people seem likely to enjoy meeting each other, MyScoutee can place them into a random group chat of 6-12 people. It is still a fresh group, but it is nudged toward people who already have enough shared interest to make the first message feel less awkward.

sections.title: Profile and photos
sections.blurb: Cards can contain more photos and a profile detail view.
sections.contentHtml: Tap the left or right image columns to browse photos. Use the eye icon to open profile details.

sections.title: Filters and modes
sections.blurb: Use the top bar to narrow who appears.
sections.contentHtml:
The filter button opens profile filters. The number shows how many results match the selected filter condition.

Preferences: normal preference-based cards. Friends in Common: people connected through someone or an event. Inside Network: pairs from your existing network. Outside Network: pairs outside it.

sections.title: History and edits
sections.contentHtml: Open history from the header or menu. In Activity ratings, use the star icon to edit a value you already gave.
